{{short description|Applied mathematician}}
{{BLP sources|date=July 2020}}
'''Basilis Gidas''' is an applied mathematician at [[Brown University]], interested in many [[Applied mathematics|applications of mathematics]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.brown.edu/academics/applied-mathematics/basilis-gidas|title=Basilis Gidas &#124; Division of Applied Mathematics|website=www.brown.edu|date=25 April 2024 }}</ref> Following degrees in electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, and mathematics, he obtained a combined Ph.D. in physics and nuclear engineering at the University of Michigan in 1970.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.genealogy.math.ndsu.nodak.edu/id.php?id=14272|title=CV |website= www.genealogy.math.ndsu.nodak.edu|access-date=2020-07-10}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=https://vivo.brown.edu/docs/b/bgidas_cv.pdf?dt=564710101|title=CV |website=vivo.brown.edu|access-date=2020-07-10}}</ref> He is an elected fellow of the [[Institute of Mathematical Statistics]]. He has had past appointments in various mathematics and physics departments at the [[Institute for Advanced Study]], [[Rutgers University]], [[Rockefeller University]], [[Bielefeld University]], [[University of Washington]], and [[University of Michigan]].

His collaborations with [[Luis Caffarelli]], [[Wei-Ming Ni]], [[Louis Nirenberg]], and [[Joel Spruck]] resulted in six papers in [[pure mathematics]], five of which rank among the most cited in the field of elliptic [[partial differential equations]]. The collaboration of Gidas, Ni, and Nirenberg in particular was cited in the awarding of the [[Abel Prize]] to Nirenberg.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.abelprize.no/binfil/download.php?tid=63545 |title=Abel Prize list  |date=2015 |website=www.abelprize.no|access-date=2020-07-10}}</ref>

==Selected publications==
*B. Gidas, [[Wei Ming Ni]], and [[Louis Nirenberg|L. Nirenberg]]. ''Symmetry and related properties via the maximum principle.'' Comm. Math. Phys. 68 (1979), no. 3, 209–243.
* B. Gidas, [[Wei Ming Ni]], and [[Louis Nirenberg|L. Nirenberg]]. ''Symmetry of positive solutions of nonlinear elliptic equations in {{math|'''R'''<sup>n</sup>}}.'' Mathematical analysis and applications, Part A, pp.&nbsp;369–402, Adv. in Math. Suppl. Stud., 7a, Academic Press, New York-London, 1981. 
* B. Gidas and [[Joel Spruck|J. Spruck]]. ''A priori bounds for positive solutions of nonlinear elliptic equations.'' Comm. Partial Differential Equations 6 (1981), no. 8, 883–901.
* B. Gidas and [[Joel Spruck|J. Spruck]]. ''Global and local behavior of positive solutions of nonlinear elliptic equations.'' Comm. Pure Appl. Math. 34 (1981), no. 4, 525–598.
*[[Luis Caffarelli|Luis A. Caffarelli]], Basilis Gidas, and [[Joel Spruck]]. ''Asymptotic symmetry and local behavior of semilinear elliptic equations with critical Sobolev growth.'' Comm. Pure Appl. Math. 42 (1989), no. 3, 271–297.
